reports.name: IRPF annual return
reports.description: Annual IRPF Form 300 return for the 2025 income year, filed during the 2026 Andorra IRPF campaign.

workflows.name: Review IRPF income
workflows.description: Review employment, self-employment, capital, real-estate, gains, deductions, and any required supporting schedules before filing.

workflows.name: Submit IRPF Form 300
workflows.description: Submit the annual IRPF return during the official campaign window.

workflows.name: Settle IRPF balance
workflows.description: Pay any balance due by the annual IRPF filing deadline or preserve the refund position.

events.title: 2025 IRPF submission window end
events.description: Form 300 for the 2025 IRPF income year may be filed from 1 April to 30 September 2026.

events.title: 2025 IRPF payment deadline
events.description: Any payable IRPF balance is due by the end of the annual filing window.

reports.name: IRPF payment on account
reports.description: September IRPF Form 320 payment on account for taxpayers with economic-activity income in 2026.

workflows.name: Confirm IRPF payment-on-account status
workflows.description: Confirm whether economic-activity income requires the September payment on account and choose the applicable calculation method.

workflows.name: Submit IRPF Form 320
workflows.description: Submit the payment-on-account declaration during the September window.

workflows.name: Pay IRPF payment on account
workflows.description: Settle the payment on account for the current IRPF period during September.

events.title: 2026 IRPF payment-on-account submission window end
events.description: Taxpayers with economic-activity income present the IRPF payment on account during September.

events.title: 2026 IRPF payment-on-account deadline
events.description: The IRPF payment on account is settled during the September payment-on-account window.

reports.name: Semiannual IGI return
reports.description: Semiannual IGI Form 900 return for taxpayers below the EUR 250,000 annual turnover threshold.

workflows.name: Confirm semiannual IGI status
workflows.description: Confirm that prior-year turnover places the taxpayer in the semiannual IGI filing frequency.

workflows.name: Submit semiannual IGI return
workflows.description: Submit the semiannual IGI declaration in July and January for the preceding semester.

workflows.name: Pay semiannual IGI
workflows.description: Pay any IGI balance before the voluntary payment window closes.

events.title: H1 2026 IGI submission window end
events.description: Semiannual IGI for the first semester is filed during July.

events.title: H1 2026 IGI payment deadline
events.description: Any payable first-semester IGI is due with the July return window.

events.title: H2 2026 IGI submission window end
events.description: Semiannual IGI for the second semester is filed during January of the following year.

events.title: H2 2026 IGI payment deadline
events.description: Any payable second-semester IGI is due with the January return window.

reports.name: Quarterly IGI return

reports.name: Corporate tax return
reports.description: Corporate tax Form 805 for the 2025 calendar-year period, filed during July 2026, with the September 2026 Form 810 payment-on-account reminder.

workflows.name: Prepare IS accounts
workflows.description: Prepare the annual accounts and corporate tax schedules before opening the Form 805 declaration.

workflows.name: Submit IS Form 805
workflows.description: Submit the corporate tax return in the natural month following the six months after the tax period closes.

workflows.name: Settle corporate tax balance
workflows.description: Pay any corporate tax balance by the end of the annual filing window.

workflows.name: Submit IS Form 810 payment on account
workflows.description: Submit the corporate tax payment-on-account declaration during the ninth month after the period starts.

events.title: 2025 IS submission window end
events.description: For a calendar-year period ending 31 December 2025, Form 805 is filed during July 2026.

events.title: 2025 IS payment deadline
events.description: Any payable corporate tax balance is due by the end of the July filing window.

events.title: 2026 IS payment-on-account submission window end
events.description: Corporate tax payment on account is filed during the ninth month after the period starts.

events.title: 2026 IS payment-on-account deadline
events.description: The corporate tax payment on account is due during the September payment-on-account window.
